title: Speedy's More Biomes
description: A mod that adds unique biomes and blocks to your game to make exploring more fun!
body:
This mod adds a bunch of new biomes with their own custom blocks that makes exploring more fun!

**BIOMES:**

- Salt Flat: A biome with a top layer made of salt blocks
- Volcanic Falls: A biome with a top layer of volcanic sand with volcanic stone underneath
- Prairie: A biome with prairie grass and oak trees
- Redwood Forest: A forest consisted of giant red trees (CUSTOM TREES IN VERSION 1.1)
- Steppe: A clear open biome with small grass dotted around
- Hemlock Forest: A biome filled with Hemlock and Fir trees
- Chestnut Forest: A biome filled with Chestnut, Hornbeam, and Hazel trees
- Ice Caves: A cave with an icy floor with icy stone underneath
- Summer Aspen Forest: A forest with Aspen trees with green leaves
- Autumn Aspen Forest: A forest with Aspen trees with yellow leaves

**NEW STRUCTURES:**

- Oasis: A structure that spawns in deserts with Palm trees around a lake of water
